profile.name: Eddy
profile.overview: Eddy is a mid-ranged stance-based mixup character. His long legs come with good pokes, lows and plus frames to control the mid range. His strings allow him to play mindgames with his opponent by threatening extensions while transitioning into stance. He can flow into and out of his two stances, Negativa (RLX) and Bananeira (HSP), quite freely, while enforcing powerful mixups from each, allowing players to layer their mixups and keep their opponents guessing constantly.
profile.playstyle: Capoeira stance mix-ups. Control the mid range with long legs, safe mids and lows, then flow into Handstand (HSP) and Relaxed (RLX) for 50/50s. Wavu warns his combos can be very specific and his counter-hit launches need fast reactions, so drill the routes.
strengths: Casino Rama: With his plethora of stances and easy entries into said stances, Eddy is perhaps the embodiment of the 50/50 mixup.
Ankle Guardian: Shares the fastest WS launcher in the game at i13. While it is a high, he can cover such lows with a Heat Engaging crouch throw or a decent WS4,4 as well.
One Moment He's There... RLX and sidestep HSP stances make Eddy very evasive and tricky to pin down. uf+2 also returns and even grants a free grounded followup.

Buttons Galore: Eddy has a surprising amount of CH tools, including a fast, low-mid launcher, fast CH mid launchers both in neutral and in stance, and a jab CH wall splat. This makes retaliating against him tricky overall, leaving him room to deal free chip with otherwise interruptible moves.
Installation Complete: Mandinga install gives Eddy more utility out of his HSP stance, including a powerful spiking mid and low.
Super Hot: Heat automatically gives him an MD stack and grants access to more plus on block moves with which to enter stance. His Heat Smash also notably enters RLX automatically if it is blocked.
weaknesses: Inconsistent: Often requires some very specific combos, even with the realignment change introduced in Season 2.

Think Fast: His CH launching moves require some level of commitment, as they are borderline unconfirmable strings rather than single hits; misuse of these tools results in a huge punish in most cases.
Low Crutch: While he has many effective lows, almost all of them are -14 on block or worse. The most rewarding of these are also on the slow side.
Lab Rat: Some strings are exploitable and do not have meaningful secondary coverage options other than simply not overextending.

Go Big or Go Home: While Eddy can play it relatively safe, it is not rewarding to do so. However, being wrong on a big read (even for his standing and crouching natural launchers) can exact equal devastation.
